title: geostat-rs: a geostatistics engine in Rust
description: Geostatistics engine in pure Rust: variography, kriging, and sequential Gaussian/indicator simulation, plus a scalable Vecchia approximation for large point sets. A modern, single-binary take on the GSLIB / gstat feature set, with deterministic stochastic simulation (seeded) and parallel prediction, validated against gstat at machine precision. Provides a Python binding and a CSV CLI.
